description:
Pepcid AC 20mg — 50 Tablets (Famotidine) is an over-the-counter product formulated to support occasional heartburn, acid indigestion, or related digestive complaints. Stored under recommended conditions at our Cabo facility.

Typical use is as directed on the manufacturer label. If symptoms persist for more than two weeks or are accompanied by warning signs, consult a healthcare provider promptly.
